description: Per-screen metadata for the 340,178 numerical records in p4_records.csv.gz. condition_vocabulary is the ordered condition one-hot vocabulary of each screen; pooled_by_seed and summary are the pooled out-of-fold scores of the original screen-specific models (random forests for Suzuki and Suzuki Bpin, XGBoost otherwise).

protocol.primary: per-seed pooled out-of-fold R2, MAE and RMSE; five seed means and ranges
protocol.sse_recovery: sum(test_rows * fold_rmse ** 2); full-precision saved losses, no refits
protocol.baseline: each held-out fold predicted by its training-fold mean yield
protocol.floor: whole source finite numeric mean yield < 0.05; zeros included, no row filtering
protocol.source_weighting: equal, descriptive; source counts are not family counts

all_sources_summary.weighting: equal source weights; five overlapping seed estimates are descriptive

nonfloor_sources_summary.weighting: equal source weights; five overlapping seed estimates are descriptive
